note: Large Tahoe NF campground run by a concessionaire on the south shore of Stampede Reservoir, with six loops among Jeffrey pines on low hills above the water; a shoreline trail, the Captain Roberts boat ramp and an amphitheater are close by. OHVs must be trailered to the trails. --Claude
summary: FS page + alerts + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + imagery/3DEP read. $23 single (double $49, triple $75), extra vehicle $10, tax; 202 sites (FS says 240+), most to 40 ft, 2 pull-through, paved; vault toilets, water, dump nearby ($10); rec.gov, some FCFS, 14-night max. Not waterfront kept (closest sites 50-60 m back through a pine stand). SEASON CONFLICT: manual 05-27..10-10 (FS) vs rec.gov's 2026/2027 season 05-22..09-26 / 05-21..09-25 - not overwritten. Pin at the entrance ~380 m from the loops' centre. Phone '' -> 530-587-3558.
flags: SEASON CONFLICT (manual season not overwritten): stored 05-27..10-10 comes from the FS page ('Seasons of Use May 27 - October 10', page updated 2026-10-13). recreation.gov sells the season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-26 and 2027-05-21 to 2027-09-25, and says the site is staffed 05/21/2027-09/25/2027 and unstaffed from 09/27/2026. There has been no first-come season after the reservable one since 2019 (2019-09-30 to 10-13). The FS dates look stale: rec.gov suggests about 05-21..09-25.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. recreation.gov lists 'Waterfront Sites' and 'Lake Access' among its facility amenities, and the FS page says 'All sites are within walking distance to the reservoir'. On imagery with all 201 positions plotted, though, the nearest sites (090, 092, 094 at the north loop's tip, 39.4691,-120.1238) are ~50-60 m from the tree line and high-water edge through a continuous pine stand. 3DEP: pad 092 is at 1818.1 m and the ground is 1813.9 m 50 m west; the reservoir high is ~1813.4 m. No named site is within ~50 m over open ground, and the pine band is too thick to give a view.

PIN ~380 m (suggested): stored 39.46434,-120.12144 is the campground entrance and fee station on Stockrest Springs Road (rec.gov's facility point is 45 m away). The nearest site is 166 m north and the loops' centre is ~380 m NW. Suggest 39.4667,-120.1246, the centroid of the 201 catalog positions. The loops span about 1 km on one entrance road, so this is not a split.
PHONE: '' -> 530-587-3558 (Truckee Ranger District, rec.gov facility phone). In season the concessionaire is at (530) 606-3978. Website unchanged.
COUNT: the rec.gov catalog has 202 sites; the FS page says 'over 240' (site numbers run to 252). Count set from the catalog.
FIT: about 19 sites are capped at 15-25 ft; 151 take 34 ft or more.
OHV: trailered access to OHV trails only, and riding inside the campground is prohibited. It is a general campground, not an OHV staging camp: flag only.
